name: operator-drive-adapter
description: Operator WebSpace resolver adapter for Runtime-mediated metadata, byte read, and mutable write-back tests
author: elastos

authority.reason: Attaches an operator-managed resolver namespace to localhost://WebSpaces without exposing resolver credentials, host paths, or raw backend APIs to app capsules.
